lines.japanese: 「……さようか。やはり救えぬと申すか」
lines.english: “...I see. So you still say there is no saving us.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶぉふん！　上等だ、さあ行くがよい。余を見捨て、愚弟どもを律して来るがいい。それが貴様の役割なのだろう」
lines.english: “Bwohm! Very well. Go, then. Abandon me and bring my foolish brothers to heel. That is your role, is it not?”

lines.japanese: 「失望したぞ、終の子よ、慈悲なき鉄面皮よ、貴様に期待した俺が間違っていたのかもしれん。所詮はただの無力な目、我々を救う翼など持ちあわせてはおらんのだ！」
lines.english: “You disappoint me, Final Child, you heartless, iron-faced wretch. Perhaps I was wrong to place my hopes in you. You are merely a powerless eye. You possess no wings with which to save us!”

lines.japanese: 「だがッ！　こ、こっ、この、このままでは俺はッ、この無間地獄より永劫出られぬであろう！」
lines.english: “But! A-at this rate, I shall never escape this hell of unbroken torment!”

lines.japanese: 「ふぬっ、ふぬん！　おのれ、もの言わぬ監査官よ、不誠実な調停官よ！　この偉大なる王がかくも平身低頭、まこと慎ましやかに願いもうしているというに！」
lines.english: “Hrm! Damn you, mute inspector, faithless mediator! The great king himself bows so low and makes so truly humble a plea!”

lines.japanese: 「ええい貴様、貴様はいったい何様だ！　我が要請を退けると申すならば、それは余にとって死刑勧告も同じ！　さあ剣を抜け、いざ尋常に勝負せん！　いずれ滅びるさだめなら戦場において雄々しく散ってみせよう！」
lines.english: “Curse you! Who do you imagine yourself to be? To deny my petition is as good as recommending my execution! Draw your sword! Face me honorably! If destruction is my fate, then I shall fall bravely upon the field of battle!”

lines.japanese: 「なぜだ、なぜ抜かん。死にかけの王とは戦えぬというか。おのれ、覚悟を決した戦士になんたる侮辱……上等だ！　覚えておれ終の子よ、奈落の名に懸けて、俺は処刑台の上から慈悲なき貴様に微笑んでみせるわ！」
lines.english: “Why? Why will you not draw? Do you refuse to fight a dying king? What an insult to a warrior resolved to die... Very well! Remember this, Final Child: by the name of the abyss, I shall smile upon your merciless face from the scaffold!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、おおーい！　ひとりでどこ行くんだよ、かるらー！」
lines.english: “Hey! Karura! Where're you going all by yourself?”

lines.japanese: 「待ってよー、おまえがいなくなっちったら向こうの行きかた、わかんねえよー！　おーい、おおーい！　かるらー、かえってこいよー」
lines.english: “Wait! If you leave, I won’t know how to get over there! Hey! Heeey! Karura, come back!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、行っちったぁ……うーん、おれこれからどーすっかなあ」
lines.english: “Aw, he’s gone... Hmm. What’m I gonna do now?”

lines.japanese: 「ポッポ心ぱいしてんのかなあ。あーあ、わるいことしちったなあ……」
lines.english: “I wonder if Poppo's worried. Aw, man. I did something bad...”

lines.japanese: 「なー。おまい、どーしたらポッポんとこ行けっか知ってるぅ？」
lines.english: “Hey. Do you know how I can get back to Poppo?”

lines.japanese: 「知らねっか。知らねんじゃしょーがねーや。はー座ろっと、っしょ」
lines.english: “Guess not. Well, if you don't know, you don't know. Might as well sit down. Heave-ho.”

lines.japanese: 「ふぁ～あ」
lines.english: “Yaaawn.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、たぁいくつだなあ、ぼりぼり……」
lines.english: “Man, this is boooring. Scratch, scratch...”

lines.japanese: 「あーそだ、夢テレビでもつけっかあ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Guess I'll turn on dream TV.”

lines.japanese: 「なんか、かるらはもう見ちゃダメってゆってたけど、しょーがねえよな、だって他になんもねーんだもん」
lines.english: “Karura said I'm not supposed to watch it anymore, but what else can I do? There isn't anything else here.”

lines.japanese: 「本モンのせかいも意外とおもしぇーかったけど、もう行けねえもんはしょーがないでー。したら夢テレビとか夢ラジオ点けとかねーと、こんなトコさびしーくて、おれアタマおかしくなっちゃうよ」
lines.english: “The real world was more fun than I expected, but if I can't go back, I can't go back. If I don't keep dream TV and dream radio on, this place is so lonely I'll go crazy.”

lines.japanese: 「……ぅー……ピー……ガガッ、ガー……」
lines.english: “...Bwee... beep... ksh, kshhh...”

lines.japanese: 「ピィ～ン……ガガッ、ザー……びゅうううううううん！」
lines.english: “Pweee... ksh... shhhh... vwoooooom!”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、始まった始まったあ。さーて、今日はなに見よっかなー。『ヨージ最高伝説』と『ヨージ連戦連勝』と『ヨージもてもて大作戦』と……ううーん、見たいのいっぱいあって迷っちゃうなあ」
lines.english: “Heh heh, it started! Now, what should I watch today? *The Legend of Yoji the Greatest*, *Yoji: Victory After Victory*, *Operation: Yoji Gets All the Girls*... Hmm, there's so much I wanna see, I can't choose.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、いいこと思いついちった！　こっちのせかいなら、じかんいくらでもあっから、ぜんぶ見ちゃえばいいんだ！　にひっ、お～れ天さ～い♪」
lines.english: “Oh! I got a great idea! There's all the time in the world here, so I'll just watch everything! Hee hee. I'm a geeeenius ♪”

lines.japanese: 「よー。おまいもこっち来て、いっしょに寝っころがんさいよー。そんなとこ立ってたって疲れるだけだでー。なー？　おまいの好きな番ぐみ、いくらでも見ていいからよー」
lines.english: Heeey. You come over here too and lie down with me. Standing around over there'll just make you tired. Okay? You can watch as much of your favorite show as you want.

lines.japanese: 「はー、やっぱじんせいは楽しく生きんのが一番だいねー。あはははは」
lines.english: Ahh, yep. Life's best when you have fun. Ahahahaha.

lines.japanese: 「ＪＯ俺Ｘ－ＴＶ、ＪＯ俺Ｘ－ＴＶ」
lines.english: “JO-ORE-X TV. JO-ORE-X TV.”

lines.japanese: 「こちらは７兆チャンネル、ＡＣＴ奈落中央テレビです」
lines.english: “This is Channel Seven Trillion, ACT Central Abyss Television.”

lines.japanese: 「妄想周波数７８．９メガハネダ、思い込み線電力２００キロヨージ」
lines.english: “Broadcasting on a delusion frequency of 78.9 mega-Haneda, with a wishful-thinking antenna power of two hundred kilo-Yoji.”

lines.japanese: 「夢幻周波数７８３．９５メガハネダ、絵空事線電力１０．２キロヨージでお送りしています……」
lines.english: “And on a fantasy frequency of 783.95 mega-Haneda, with a make-believe antenna power of 10.2 kilo-Yoji...”
